$comment: English overlay DECISION-0070: unofficial model labels for the English MCP slice `charter` (the Charter imports this bridge vocabulary). Not compiled into CLIR.

Homo.text: a human being as the holder of a claimed right

Actus.text: the contested act of a State, group or person

Civitas.text: a State or other political community

ius_declaratum.text: a human right concerning this act is declared by the instrument

limitatio_admissa.text: a limitation of the human right concerning the act is permitted by the instrument

remedium_patet.text: a remedy concerning the act is available to the person

quaestio_organo_tradita.text: the question of the act is referred to an organ named by the instrument
